verdict.rationale: Runloop's core product is isolated sandboxes (Devboxes), documented as "secure sandboxed execution environments" and as "isolated Linux sandbox environments" for AI agents. Supporting docs cover snapshot and rollback to known-good states, egress network policies, and Agent Gateways and an MCP hub that keep credentials away from agents, so agents can test in a separate environment. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the isolation, and explicit documentation of keeping test work separate from production data (it is implied by the sandbox model rather than stated).
